In this video we cover:
Varun Beverages Bets Big on Africa Amid Health Drink Boom
India’s beverage market is shifting towards low- and no-sugar drinks, now making up 55% of Varun Beverages’ sales. While Indian volumes dropped in Q2 2025, profits still grew, driven by healthier drinks and strong performance in Africa. The company is expanding across African countries, investing in snacks and production lines, and sees the region as a key growth engine despite infrastructure and competition challenges.
